title: Education Gamification | Cornucopias
description:
Lots of new development: BSC Staking Pool, Education Gamification, Tokenomics Paper and MUCH MORE!

In this episode of COPICafe Josh and Rob discuss the new BSC Stake Pool, the upcoming tokenomics paper and gush over an internal video of Solace. They also welcome Matt on the show for his second appearance to discuss the upcoming cNFTcon and Rare Bloom conferences, his dive into Unreal Engine becoming a metaverse photographer and a lot more details on the education gamification. The guys finish up the episode with some community questions and a couple leaks at the end. 

Post your contest entries into the "Word Game" channel in Discord.

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw 

00:00 - Intro 
00:41 - Beverage Choices
02:25 - BSC Staking Pool
03:04 - Tokenomics Paper
04:05 - CNFT + Bloom Conference
07:53 - Word Game
10:13 - Internal Solace Video
12:45 - Special Guest - Matt
14:27 - Booth Design
18:27 - Metaverse Photographer
22:26 - Education Gamification
29:22 - Community Questions
38:32 - LEAKS

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK 

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
